description:
Welcome to the world of Timpy Doctor Games for Kids, where the excitement never ends! Enter the hospital and play as a doctor. Using an X-Ray machine, you'll be able to take a look inside his hand and diagnose the problem. If you find a broken bone, show off your skills with a fun and interactive drag-and-drop game that will have you setting bones like a pro in no time. First, thoroughly clean the wound, then apply plaster to the tiger's hand to complete the treatment. Reward him for being a good boy with a tasty drink!
